title: pvAppendReduce
body:
## pvAppendReduce

Parallel data-movement filter (vtkReductionFilter with vtkAppendFilter as the post-gather helper): it gathers the pieces of a distributed dataset from all MPI processes and appends them into one unstructured grid on one process or on every process. Use it in MPI runs when a later step needs the whole dataset in one place; in a serial run there is only process 0, so it just appends the single piece. Input must be a non-composite vtkDataSet. To combine separate nodes use append or merge.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Gathering a large mesh onto one process can exceed that process's memory.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendReduce`. Identity: `filters/AppendReductionFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Reduction filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GenerateProcessIds` | If true, the filter will generate vtkOriginalProcessIds arrays indicating the process id on which the cell/point was generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `OnlyFrom` | If set to a non-negative value, then produce results using only the node Id specified. | `{"minimum":-1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-1` |
| `PostGatherHelperName` | Set the algorithm that takes multiple inputs and produces a single reduced output. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ReduceTo` | Set the process to reduce to. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `ReductionMode` | Set the reduction mode. Reducing all data to one processor means that the destination process will have all data while each other process will still have it's own data. Moving all to one processor means that the destination process will have all data while other process have no data anymore. Reduce all data to all processors is self explanatory. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Reduce all data to one processor","Move all data to one processor","Reduce all data to all processors"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Reduce all data to one processor"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendReduce",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
